$comment: Website as a Funnel layer 1 (docs/website-as-a-funnel-framework-2026-09-28.md): every tool, plugin, credential and data source used to understand alpha.school as a funnel. status: held (we can use it), present (exists, no access or unverified), absent (not installed), unknown. null = unconfirmed; verify, fill, commit; never guess. Health of each tool is layer 2 (measurement-integrity lane).

owner.note: role exists in registry/owners.json as a gap; Matt Barge proposed as interim owner of definitions and access, Yash Chitneni for HubSpot reporting

tools.name: Google Tag Manager
tools.note: On every page through Site Kit; noscript iframe emitted twice per page; contents unreadable from HTML; no dataLayer pushes or gtag events on any CTA.

tools.name: Google tag (gtag.js)
answers: pageviews into the GA4 property behind it
tools.note: Read from Site Kit settings 2026-09-28. Cross-domain linker lists alpha.school only; go., events. and apply. subdomains are not linked, so sessions break at every conversion click.

tools.name: Google Analytics 4 property

readPaths: Site Kit REST proxy (modules/analytics-4/data/report) once a WordPress admin user has granted Site Kit the analytics.readonly scope with a Google account that can view the property
GA4 Data API with a service account granted Viewer on property 452530593

tools.note: Property ids read from Site Kit settings on 2026-09-28 (wp-json/google-site-kit/v1/modules/analytics-4/data/settings). No credential in any repo yet; Site Kit reports answer 403 missing_required_scopes for the agent user (Matt Barge, WordPress user 34) until that user authenticates Site Kit with Google.

tools.name: Google Search Console

access.siteKit: connected, owner info@alpha.school; proxy 403 for the agent user until Google-authenticated
access.observerActions: not configured: the aeo repo holds GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and SECRET but no GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_REFRESH_TOKEN; health.json reports "Google Search Console OAuth is not configured"

tools.note: The observer has the code path and the OAuth client but no refresh token, so nothing reads Search Console today. Corrected 2026-09-28 from an earlier "held".

tools.name: Google Site Kit (WordPress plugin)
answers: ties WordPress to the Google account that owns the tag and property

access.googleAccount: the account behind WordPress admin "Alpha School" (info@alpha.school); modules analytics-4, search-console and pagespeed-insights are shareable

tools.note: Site Kit exposes property, stream, tag and Search Console settings through its REST API to any WordPress admin; report data needs the calling WordPress user to be Google-authenticated in Site Kit.

tools.name: HubSpot tracking script (leadin)
answers: identified sessions once a contact is known
tools.note: Passive: setContentType only. The identity join for current versus prospective parents depends on it plus HubSpot reporting access.

tools.name: HubSpot reporting (meetings, marketing events, forms analytics)
tools.note: Existing apps carry content and CRM-read scopes and Program writes; none carries meetings, marketing-events analytics or forms analytics.

tools.name: UTM to first-party cookie script
answers: campaign attribution carried to HubSpot forms

access.where: global inline JavaScript in the document head

tools.note: Writes every utm_* query value to a 30-day cookie without Secure or SameSite; nothing reads it in page HTML; owner unknown.

tools.name: Consent management (HubSpot cookie banner)
answers: whether tags may fire per region

access.where: HubSpot Privacy and Consent settings for portal 40051392; the banner is injected at runtime by the HubSpot loader when enabled

tools.note: No banner or consent call is in the static HTML; if one exists it is HubSpot-rendered at runtime and must be confirmed from a browser render (observer). Earlier "absent" downgraded to unknown on 2026-09-28.

tools.name: Meta pixel

access.where: inside GTM (not in page HTML); Meta Events Manager

tools.note: Id supplied by the 2026-09-28 shareable inventory; only a dns-prefetch is visible in HTML. LinkedIn: no live marker.

tools.name: Voiceflow chat widget
answers: chat leads (name, email, phone, school of interest)
tools.note: Configured for a 20 percent visitor rollout (2026-09-28 inventory); submits leads to Voiceflow, not HubSpot; no analytics event.

tools.name: Ask MacKenzie founder chat
tools.note: Off unless the agent query parameter is present.

tools.name: YouTube embeds
tools.note: Plain embeds; no player API events; MacKenzie asked for video drop-off and a mid-video prompt.

tools.name: Podcast card ordering
tools.note: Order automated on listens plus trend; weekly performance email promised 2026-09-25.

tools.name: Alpha site observer (superbuilders/aeo)
tools.note: Measures conformance of the rendered site twice daily; reads no analytics. audience-funnel loop is one advisory CTA-routing check.

tools.name: Campus CTA inventory
answers: conversion destinations per campus and control
tools.note: Snapshot; must become live before attribution is built on it.

tools.name: Alpha WordPress MCP
tools.note: No analytics ability.

tools.name: n8n workflows
answers: what HubSpot fields reach the page

tools.name: Student information system
answers: who is a current student (for current-parent identification and quote currency)
tools.note: Named by MacKenzie 2026-09-25; system and owner not yet named.

tools.name: Cloudflare (in front of production)
answers: edge requests, bandwidth, cache, bots, threats, availability
tools.note: Web Analytics beacon is off; no account access recorded.

tools.name: Local SEO dashboard skeleton
tools.note: All rows null; build-versus-archive decision pending with Yash.

tools.name: Approved claims and testimonials registries
answers: which claim may appear where, with evidence
tools.note: not-yet-created; the observer's claims loop is advisory until they exist.

tools.name: Rio SEO Local Manager
answers: Google Business Profile and directory listings per campus
tools.owner: Cristi Constantin (pushes data by API; no longer edits in Local Manager)
tools.note: The listings and local-SEO vendor; the "rhino" tool Matt recalled on 2026-09-28. Not web analytics.

tools.name: Peec AI
answers: which AI answer surfaces cite alpha.school and which sources shape the answers
tools.note: Answer-engine visibility, not site traffic; the AEO brainlift records that Peec cannot do attribution.

tools.name: Google Workspace service account (observer)
answers: can be granted Viewer on the GA4 property to read the Data API without a person
tools.note: Email unknown to this workspace (inside the secret); read from the aeo repo secret by whoever holds it, then add as Viewer on GA4 property 452530593.

tools.name: mattbarge-superbuilderscontext repo
answers: credential catalogue, collaborators, project overviews, brainlifts (AEO, Joe messaging)
tools.note: Holds no Google Analytics credential as of 2026-09-28; the GA4 property was found through Site Kit.

tools.name: Google Ads

access.where: Google Ads under Goals and Audiences; tag deployed inside GTM

tools.note: Linked to the GA4 property (adsLinked true in Site Kit).

tools.name: PostHog
answers: sessions, events and feature flags inside the Community app and Alpha Camp (not the marketing site)

access.where: posthog-js bundled in the Community app (community.alpha.school) and in Alpha Camp (PostHogProvider, us.posthog.com); alpha-camp .env carries POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN and POSTHOG_HOST

recordedIn: marketingsupport work-assets sweep-2026-09-24-observer community entry.js capture
tools.note: Not installed on alpha.school. Relevant to the current-parent question: the Community app is where enrolled families act, and PostHog is its analytics. The tool Matt recalled on 2026-09-28.

tools.name: WP Engine
answers: origin traffic, cache behaviour, errors, logs

tools.name: Goldcast
answers: info-session registrations and attendance (with HubSpot Marketing Events)
tools.note: One of the five outcome systems.

tools.name: Finalsite application
answers: application starts and submissions for campuses routed to /application-fs/
tools.note: Application outcome lives here or in the HubSpot application form depending on the campus.

tools.name: Community app
answers: community and waitlist signups; where enrolled families act

tools.name: YouTube Studio
answers: views, watch time, retention per video
tools.note: The only place video drop-off (MacKenzie ask) can be read today.
